messages:
Maria: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's degraded deploy. TL;DR: rollout misrouted ~30% traffic to a broken model variant, quick manual rollback mitigated, but pager fatigue + delayed auto-rollback were contributing factors.

Sam: Thanks. Can we capture the timeline and owners here? I can own the auto-rollback work if that's helpful.

Maria: @Sam that'd be great. Timeline idea: discovery->short term patches (48h), mid-term (2w) for feature-flag guardrails, long-term (1mo) for flagging infra and rollback simulation.

Priya: Suggested short-term patches: 1) enforce feature flag scope limits (max %), 2) add opt-out circuit for model variant routing, 3) alert on sudden traffic delta >10% in 5m. I can take 1 and 3.

Sam: I'll take 2 (routing opt-out) + implement an automatic rollback trigger. Proposal: rollback if error rate >5% OR latency p95 >2s for 3 consecutive minutes.

Lee: From SRE side we should add a canary pain metric and a canned runbook. I'll draft a runbook snippet:
```
# rollback trigger
if canary.error_rate > 0.05 for 3m:
  trigger: featureflag.rollback(variant)
  notify: #eng-oncall, #eng-platform
```

Oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2028-0456 (link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2028-0456) :rotating_light: 

Tom: Two operational notes: a) ensure KMS for flag admin calls is audited, b) add throttles to the rollout controller to cap burst deploys.

Maria: Action items with owners and due dates:
- Sam: auto-rollback implementation (PRs + unit tests) — due 2026-04-05
- Priya: feature flag scope limit + delta alerts — due 2026-03-30
- Lee: runbook + canary metric instrumentation — due 2026-03-28
- Tom: rollout controller throttle + audit events — due 2026-04-09

Sam: I'll drop a draft PR link when ready. Also want to run a simulated rollback drill next week — can we schedule a 30m run with oncall? @Maria

Maria: Yes. Proposed drill window: 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC. Goals: verify rollback works from both Console and API, measure MTTR, confirm alerts and incident creation.

Priya: I'll prepare a small harness to simulate traffic spike and variant bug.

Lee: I'll add a Grafana dashboard panel for the canary pain metric and a synthetic check.

Tom: FYI we should coordinate with Product to set acceptable thresholds. I'll ping Product in #product.

Maria: Noted. Recurring pattern note: this is the third model-routing incident in 9 months. We should prioritize making rollbacks autonomous where safe, and schedule quarterly drills.

Sam: Agreed. Will add a recurring calendar invite for rollout drills (quarterly) and an RFC for auto-rollback constraints.

Maria: Thanks team. I'll update the postmortem with these actions and close the follow-ups once PRs merged and drill complete. :white_check_mark:
